title: feat: add OAuth2 login flow
author: alice
body:
Adds an OAuth2 authorization-code login flow.

Closes #471. Related to SITES-1234.

- New `AuthClient` wraps the provider handshake
- Session tokens stored in an httpOnly cookie
- Adds retry on transient token-exchange failures

reviewComments.author: bob
reviewComments.body: exchangeCode doesn't handle a non-200 response from the token endpoint.

conversationComments.author: carol
conversationComments.body: Can we get an integration test for the cookie flags?

linkedIssues.title: Support OAuth2 login
linkedIssues.body: Users want to log in with their corporate SSO provider via OAuth2.
